e.title: Security Decision Labs
e.summary: FAIR 网安风险量化工具集（30★）：LEF/LM 蒙特卡洛模拟、组合聚合、IRIS 2025 基准、agent-based 控制模拟
e.summary_en: FAIR cyber risk quantification toolkit (30★): LEF/LM Monte Carlo simulation, portfolio aggregation, IRIS 2025 benchmarks, agent-based control simulation
e.summary_hk: FAIR 網安風險量化工具集（30★）：LEF/LM 蒙特卡洛模擬、組合聚合、IRIS 2025 基準、agent-based 控制模擬
e.body:
Security Decision Labs（security-decision-science，30★，2026-07 活跃）是 FAIR（信息风险因子分析）网安风险量化工具集：LEF（损失事件频率）/LM（损失幅度）蒙特卡洛模拟、组合聚合、敏感性分析、IRIS 2025 行业基准、agent-based 控制模拟（FAIR-CAM）、威胁事件频率估计器（PyPI）。对 RIAA：网安保险定价的建模方法——FAIR 是网安风险量化的行业标准方法论（[[cyber-risk-platform]] 核保工具的建模层）；组合聚合/敏感性分析支持网安保险组合管理；注意许可为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0（非商业）；与 [[reinsurance]]、[[aggregate-python]]（聚合损失）配套；适合网安保险与新兴风险方向。

## 同类工具
[[smarp]]、[[splice]]、[[survpen]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
Security Decision Labs (security-decision-science, 30★, active 2026-07) is a FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk) cyber risk quantification toolkit: LEF (loss event frequency)/LM (loss magnitude) Monte Carlo simulation, portfolio aggregation, sensitivity analysis, IRIS 2025 industry benchmarks, agent-based control simulation (FAIR-CAM), threat event frequency estimator (PyPI). For RIAA: the modelling approach for cyber insurance pricing — FAIR is the industry-standard methodology for cyber risk quantification (the modelling layer of [[cyber-risk-platform]] underwriting tools); portfolio aggregation/sensitivity analysis support cyber portfolio management; note the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial) licence; pairs with [[reinsurance]] and [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate losses); suits cyber insurance and emerging risks.
